build_text_to_image_pipeline: build a TextToImagePipeline that loads a diffusion model from a Hugging Face model ID for text-to-image generation
generate_image_from_text: generate a PIL Image from a text prompt using the TextToImagePipeline call method with optional scheduler and seed parameters
load_sd_with_sdxl_fix: load a Stable Diffusion XL model with an fp16 VAE fix using the _load_sd_with_sdxl_fix method
swap_diffusion_scheduler: swap the diffusion scheduler dynamically by passing a compatible scheduler name in the kwargs when calling the pipeline
process_request_with_seed: process a text-to-image request with a manual seed by passing a seed parameter to control reproducibility
